finalText:
Fixed the connection leak. The problem was in `src/jobs/processOrder.js` — when an order failed validation, the exception was thrown before the `pool.release()` line, leaking the connection forever. Since there's no timeout-based reclaim in the pool (as the comment notes), a single missed release is permanent.

Added try/finally to guarantee release even if validation fails, matching the pattern already used in the API handler. All four tests pass, including the critical one that checks failed orders don't leak.
